evidence.observation: Growth setpoint tracked; initial ~12 °C offset settled to 750 °C by k~50 and held through end of growth
Flow at 100 sccm in growth, stepping cleanly to 200 sccm at cooldown
Stable ~3.06 Torr in growth with a brief benign excursion to ~3.32 Torr at k=118-121, then ~4.06 Torr during higher-flow cooldown
Heater power drops to ~0% at cooldown with steady ~2 °C/5 s decay

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (e.g., Raman/PL/AFM or optical imaging) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew.
